name: localai
description: A lightweight, local-first AI model serving platform for deploying and managing machine learning models.
rationale: The current landscape lacks a simple, efficient, and local-first solution for serving AI models. This tool would fill that gap, making it easier for developers to deploy and use AI models without relying on cloud services.
goals: Provide a lightweight, local-first AI model serving platform
Enable easy deployment and management of machine learning models
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
